limitations: No image, audio or video was inspected or generated.
Prompt timing, physical descriptions and author-reported outcomes are source text, not measurements by this implementation.
Only read_receipts and listed line_ranges support semantic-read claims; keyword indexing does not establish full reading.
The case-specific numbers of segments, cuts, seconds, garment designs, support side and props are not universal defaults.
The source cases include legacy/custom prompt syntax; official syntax comes from the separately pinned MiniMax sources.
No directly read case demonstrates a time-jump, flashback or injury continuity rule; support for those is explicit contract design with unknown content until supplied.
Distinct state values and state intervals are different counts. The contact-cut case does not assert repeated stocking values; return-to-earlier-value support is a derived contract rule.
